title: Senior Application Security Engineer
Senior Solutions Architect, Agentic AI — Safety and Security
description_html: We are looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to help leading Enterprise ISVs design, build, and deploy secure agentic AI systems on NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platform. In this role, we will partner with strategic software companies across cybersecurity, AI safety, infrastructure protection, and confidential computing. Together, we will help them build trustworthy AI products that meet enterprise expectations for security, privacy, safety, reliability, and performance. This work includes multi-agent orchestration, guardrails, agent runtime security, RAG, tool use, model customization, policy enforcement, OpenShell-like execution environments, and confidential AI deployments on protected infrastructure.    What you'll be doing:    Lead strategic agentic AI partner engagements from discovery and architecture through PoC, production readiness, rollout, and scale.  Build enterprise-grade agentic AI systems with multi-agent workflows, tool-using agents, RAG, planning, memory, evaluation, guardrails, policy enforcement, and failure containment.  Partner with security ISVs to integrate NVIDIA models into detection and response products, including threat triage, investigation agents, remediation workflows, natural-language-to-query, analyst automation, PII handling, and content safety.  Architect secure and confidential AI deployments using NVIDIA Confidential Computing, GPU attestation, KMS integration, protected infrastructure, air-gapped patterns, and partner key-management workflows.  Create PoCs, benchmarks, reference architectures, reusable blueprints, field guidance, and product feedback that help NVIDIA and our partners move secure AI systems into production.     What we need to see:    BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI/ML, or equivalent experience  8+ years in engineering, solutions architecture, applied ML, enterprise software, or technical deployment.  Experience leading AI, ML, distributed systems, or enterprise software projects from prototype to production.  Hands-on experience building LLM, generative AI, RAG, or agentic AI applications in production or production-like environments.  Depth in one or more areas such as AI/LLM security, enterprise cybersecurity, trust and safety, confidential computing, secure AI infrastructure, model customization, post-training, or model evaluation.  Strong Python and Linux skills, experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar frameworks, and working knowledge of risks such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool-based data exfiltration, unsafe tool invocation, and model or skill supply-chain risk.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    Background with NVIDIA AI software such as NIM, NeMo Framework, NeMo Retriever, NeMo Guardrails, NeMo Agent Toolkit, Dynamo, Nemotron, Nemotron Safety models, Triton, TensorRT-LLM, or NIM Operator.  Experience with LLM red-teaming, AI safety evaluation, adversarial testing, prompt-injection defense, policy enforcement, Garak, NeMo Auditor, or release-gating evaluation benchmarks.  Background with OpenShell, agent harnesses, sandboxed execution, secure tool invocation, agent runtime security, AI/software supply-chain security, model or skill signing, provenance, attestation, VEX, or secure model registries.  Experience building post-training pipelines or GPU-accelerated safety and security workflows, including reasoning, tool use, domain adaptation, safety alignment, PII/NER detection, content-safety models, TensorRT optimization, quantization, workshops, architecture reviews, whitepapers, or reference architectures.  Experience with confidential computing, including GPU confidential computing, remote attestation, Confidential Containers, enterprise KMS, air-gapped deployments, AMD SEV-SNP, or Intel TDX.    With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. This role presents an opportunity to have a wide impact at NVIDIA by improving the factory planning function. Are you creative, hard-working, dedicated, and determined? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you!     Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD - 287,500 USD.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 6, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Security Compliance
Software Product Security Engineer - HP IQ
location: San Francisco, California, United States of America
description_html: Software Product Security Engineer - HP IQ    Description -    About the Role    As a  Software Engineer specializing in Device Security , you will contribute to building secure, privacy-focused technologies for HP IQ's next generation of AI-enabled devices. You’ll work alongside experienced security, firmware, operating system, hardware, and cloud engineers to help protect customer data and strengthen the security of our products.    In this role, you’ll develop and implement security features across embedded systems, PCs, and server-class workstations. You’ll gain hands-on experience with areas such as secure boot, cryptography, device identity, secure communication, and data protection while contributing to products throughout the development lifecycle.    This is an opportunity for an engineer who has a strong foundation in software development and an interest in device security to deepen their technical expertise while working on complex, real-world security challenges.    What You Might Do     Develop and implement security features for embedded and connected devices, including secure boot, key management, encryption, device identity, and data protection.    Contribute to the design and implementation of secure software components using established security architectures and industry best practices.    Collaborate with engineers across CoreOS, Firmware, Design, Hardware, and Cloud Services to integrate security capabilities into HP IQ products.    Develop and maintain software in C, C++, Java, or related languages across embedded, AOSP, Linux, or Windows environments.    Contribute to TrustZone, TEE, kernel-level, or other hardware-backed security applications with guidance from experienced engineers.    Help implement secure communication channels between devices and services while protecting sensitive and personal data.    Work with biometric sensors and other hardware components to support secure data flows across device boundaries.    Participate in threat modeling, security reviews, vulnerability analysis, testing, and remediation activities.    Apply secure software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices throughout the development process.    Investigate security issues, troubleshoot software and system-level problems, and contribute to solutions that improve product security and reliability.     Essential Qualifications     Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.    Typically 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience, including experience with embedded systems, operating systems, firmware, or security-related development.    Programming experience in C, C++, Java, or a similar systems programming language.    Foundational understanding of software and device security concepts such as secure boot, cryptography, authentication, access control, PKI, or application sandboxing.    Experience developing or debugging software in embedded, Linux, AOSP, Windows, or similar environments.    Understanding of software development fundamentals, including debugging, testing, code reviews, source control, and software development lifecycle practices.    Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers and cross-functional partners to solve technical problems.    Strong interest in developing deeper expertise in device security, cryptography, privacy, and secure systems.     Preferred Skills     Experience or coursework involving embedded systems, consumer electronics, IoT, operating systems, firmware, or device security.    Familiarity with AOSP or Linux security technologies such as TrustZone, TEE, Android Verified Boot (AVB), Keystore, or SELinux.    Familiarity with common cryptographic concepts, authentication mechanisms, certificates, or PKI.    Exposure to hardware-backed security, secure elements, TPMs, biometric systems, or trusted execution environments.    Experience with security testing, vulnerability analysis, threat modeling, or secure coding practices.    Familiarity with privacy and security frameworks or standards such as GDPR, CCPA, or ISO.    Curiosity and a desire to continue developing expertise in security, privacy, embedded     systems, and emerging technologies.      Salary: $107,400-$155,700       Compensation & Benefits (Full-Time Employees)  The salary range for this role is listed above. Final salary offered is based upon multiple factors including individual job-related qualifications, education, experience, knowledge and skills.
